tools.description: Open roles per brand by department and location, change vs last check, top job titles and newly added or removed jobs - an early read on where a rival is investing.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_homepage_top_links, get_significant_competitor_changes, get_meta_ads_reach_messages_and_landing_pages, get_newly_published_products_and_pages, get_technology_stack, get_email_newsletter_insights, get_competitor_moves_feed, get_customer_reviews_analysis · Private data: check_brand_data_coverage, get_active_promotions_and_coupons, get_brand_price_statistics, find_closest_competitor_brands, get_homepage_top_links, get_ai_agent_readiness_score, get_full_brand_snapshot, get_my_usage_and_plan, get_significant_competitor_changes, request_new_brand_monitoring · Public sink: check_brand_data_coverage, get_brand_price_statistics, get_homepage_product_shelf_and_markdowns, get_newly_published_products_and_pages, get_technology_stack, get_email_newsletter_insights · Destructive: get_meta_ads_reach_messages_and_landing_pages, get_discount_frequency_and_depth.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_homepage_top_links, get_significant_competitor_changes, get_meta_ads_reach_messages_and_landing_pages, get_newly_published_products_and_pages, get_technology_stack, get_email_newsletter_insights, get_competitor_moves_feed, get_customer_reviews_analysis · Private data: check_brand_data_coverage, get_active_promotions_and_coupons, get_brand_price_statistics, find_closest_competitor_brands, get_homepage_top_links, get_ai_agent_readiness_score, get_full_brand_snapshot, get_my_usage_and_plan, get_significant_competitor_changes, request_new_brand_monitoring · Public sink: check_brand_data_coverage, get_brand_price_statistics, get_homepage_product_shelf_and_markdowns, get_newly_published_products_and_pages, get_technology_stack, get_email_newsletter_insights · Destructive: get_meta_ads_reach_messages_and_landing_pages, get_discount_frequency_and_depth

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
